title: Basie raiding his band in Kansas City
summary: In Kansas City, Basie, then with Gonzelle White, took Roy's saxophonist Hildred Humphries and his banjoist; Roy explains how musicians were recruited.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: And I was also there after that show broke up... See, we left... When we got from the South there, we come to Kansas City, and we played at the Eighteenth Street Theatre. That's when Basie stole my saxophone player and my banjo player. Because Basie was with Gonzelle White then, you know. I looked up, and he got both of them and gone!

Hildred Humphries and... I forget the big old banjo player's name; I don't think he ever amounted to anything. Hildred was doing all right for a while, but he's in some kind of other business. He lives upstate there somewhere. Do you know Frank Humphries?
Yeah! With Gonzelle White... He was with Gonzelle White, you know.
How did they do that? Would they come up to a guy and say, "Hey, come with us and you'll make more money" and so on?

He was offering him a job, because the money was a meal-ticket type of thing with us, you know, and me being the leader, maybe I might get five dollars extra a week or something like that. Cats just... It was very simple. You'd meet the cat somewhere: "Hey, come over here. You'll get this. They ain't doin' nothin'..."
